items.title: P-type semiconductor ka banna (print mein 2.11.1) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 2.11.1 under 2.10, printed page 42.

blocks.text: Pure semiconductor mein teen valence electrons wale impurity atoms (jaise Al) milaye jate hain. Kuch trivalent atoms crystal mein Si atoms ki jagah le lete hain. Ab wahan chaar bonds poore nahi ban sakte kyun ke ek electron kam hai. Is liye crystal lattice mein ek khaali jagah, yani “hole”, ban jati hai jo positive charge carrier ka kaam karti hai (Figure 2.18). Is tarah positive-type, yani P-type, semiconductor banta hai. Bahar ke current source se electrons is semiconductor mein se guzar sakte hain, is liye yeh conductor ki tarah kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ‘Figure 1.15’ likhti hai; sahi Figure 2.18 hai. Kitab yeh bhi likhti hai ‘positive-type semiconductor or N-type semiconductor’; sahi: positive-type = P-type.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Hole ko ek khaali kursi samjhein: paas ka electron us mein aa baithta hai aur apne peeche nayi khaali jagah chhor deta hai. Yun hole aage barhta lagta hai, jaise positive charge chal raha ho.

blocks.prompt: Boron ki configuration 2, 3 hai. Silicon ko boron se dope karne se P-type semiconductor kyun banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Boron sirf teen valence electrons lata hai jabke chaar bonds chahiye, is liye ek bond mein electron kam reh jata hai: ek hole. Holes positive charge carriers hain, is liye yeh P-type hai.

items: Trivalent impurity (Al, B) Si ki jagah le kar ek bond adhoora chhorti hai: hole = positive carrier: P-type.
